text: 1351 sets explicit root, link and detail text colors in generated Filelink markup, reduces padding and gives the HTML list a white background. Accepted source retains these inline styles. This is a scoped generated-message pattern: compose application theme variables do not automatically become a recipient’s rendering environment. It is not a rule to hard-code colors in ordinary application CSS, and cross-client/dark-theme appearance was not rendered. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Filelink transmitted markup carries stable inline colors independent of the compose theme
